_comment: Global hook manifest. installer/install-claude-layer.py turns each entry into a settings.json hook for the current platform (darwin, linux, win32), skipping entries whose platforms list does not include it. {{PYTHON}} is the interpreter that ran the installer, {{CLAUDE_HOME}} the Claude home it installed into. The gstack AskUserQuestion hooks (PreToolUse question-preference, PostToolUse question-log and auq-error-fallback) are not listed here: the gstack setup registers them itself when --upstream-skills installs it.

hooks.guards: blocks pkill, killall, kill fed by pgrep, and rm with a glob
pauses all work at 98% of the weekly usage limit, except recording where work stopped
build and service agents read images over 1600 px downscaled or cropped (macOS: uses sips)
saves the owner's last messages, running agents and state files before a compact
injects that snapshot right after the compact
injects docs/orchestration.md into main sessions only, never into subagents
tells a main session when Vault OS is outdated, unstamped or half-upgraded (one GitHub version check a day, offline-safe)
keeps the Mac awake while a session works, lets it sleep when idle (macOS: caffeinate)
plays the Hero sound twice when a turn ends, so it is heard from another room (macOS: afplay)
